clue.text: Dutiful rider accepting financial liability

indicators.note: a rider that accepts something takes it in, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: a rider added to a letter is a postscript, PS
an IOU is a written acknowledgement of a debt

explanation.surface: A horse rider dutifully shouldering a money debt.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone devout is faithful to religious duty, so dutiful is a fair synonym.

clue.text: A buttress on the beach

parts.note: to shore up is to buttress; a shore is a prop or support

explanation.surface: A supporting wall stands on the seafront.
explanation.definitionFit: Landed on dry land by the sea, as a sailor coming in from a ship.

clue.text: Sort of mattress considered most chic

indicators.note: to sort letters is to rearrange them, so this signals a reshuffle of the next word

explanation.surface: A type of bed mattress judged the most fashionable.
explanation.definitionFit: Chic and stylish are synonyms of smart, so most chic is the superlative.

clue.text: Figures there's some point in standing

indicators.note: the point is placed in the word for standing

parts.note: one's standing is one's status
E, east, is one of the compass points

explanation.surface: Asking whether there is any purpose in remaining on one's feet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some point' is a compass point, E, set inside STATUS between its U and S.
explanation.definitionFit: Sculpted figures in stone or bronze are statues.

clue.text: Member of more than one union? That's criminal!

definitions.text: Member of more than one union? That's criminal!

parts.words: Member of more than one union? That's criminal!
parts.note: reads like a trade unionist with dual membership, but the union is marriage and being married twice at once is a crime

explanation.definitionFit: Someone married to two spouses at the same time commits an offence in most countries.

clue.text: Sign-writing

parts.note: not the painting of shop signs, but writing done in symbols or signs, as stenographers use

explanation.definitionFit: A system of quick note-taking in symbols is a form of writing with signs.

clue.text: Eve is a sea-going officer

definitions.meaning: in Genesis Eve was the earliest wife, partner of Adam
the deck officer next below the captain on a merchant ship

explanation.definitionFit: Eve was the original spouse in the Bible; on a ship the chief deputy to the master holds that rank.

clue.text: Simple form of illumination

definitions.meaning: a lamp or source of brightness

explanation.definitionFit: Light means undemanding or easy, and also a lamp that gives brightness.

clue.text: Teachers have to suffer

indicators.note: the word teachers has these letters inside it

explanation.surface: School staff must put up with hardship.
explanation.definitionFit: To feel continuous pain is to suffer.

clue.text: His word is law at a court function

indicators.note: the three words are made to work in a different arrangement

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A man whose word counts at a royal court gathering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'function' looks like a social event at court, but it signals that AT A COURT is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A ruler with absolute power issues commands that must be obeyed.

clue.text: Woman finding sanctuary within the Church

indicators.note: one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
a lair is an animal's den, a refuge

explanation.surface: A woman takes refuge inside a church.
explanation.definitionFit: A female given name.

clue.text: Holiday in Tenerife -Tenerife in the Canaries

indicators.note: the letters are found inside the repeated island name

explanation.surface: A vacation on Tenerife, one of the Canary Islands.
explanation.walkthrough: The end of the first Tenerife and the start of the second give the run.
explanation.definitionFit: A festival or celebration day is a holiday.

clue.text: Sense men in a boat will get around OK

indicators.note: the crew surround the word for OK

parts.note: a rowing crew of eight oarsmen is called an eight
yes means OK as agreement

explanation.surface: Rowers in a boat will manage around a bend safely.
explanation.walkthrough: An EIGHT is a rowing boat crewed by eight rowers.
explanation.definitionFit: Sight is one of the five senses.

clue.text: With fences deals paid off

indicators.note: off suggests something gone wrong, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Agreements to pay for fencing have been settled.
explanation.definitionFit: A palisade is a fence of stakes, so this means enclosed by such barriers.

clue.text: Quiet tears about a previous generation

indicators.note: the combined pieces go around the single letter

parts.note: p is the musical marking for piano, quiet
rents are rips or tears
taken as written

explanation.surface: Silent weeping over a generation gone by.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tears' looks like crying but means rips.
explanation.definitionFit: Mothers and fathers are the generation before their children.

clue.text: Stay in play

parts.note: a stay is a pause, so a pause during a stage performance, not staying in the game

explanation.definitionFit: An interval between the acts of a theatrical show.

clue.text: Poor thing it may be, but striking

indicators.note: the words are in poor shape, so rearranged

explanation.surface: Something may be a shabby object yet still impressive.
explanation.definitionFit: Striking means delivering a blow, as hitting does.

clue.text: Tax on gold leading to fraudster

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece is placed on top of the second

parts.note: an impost is a tax or duty
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A levy on gold paves the way for a swindler.
explanation.definitionFit: A cheat pretending to be someone else is a fraudster.

clue.text: Dealing with travel documentation and money changing

parts.note: re means concerning or dealing with
a visa is an entry permit stamped in a passport
L is the pound sign, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Sorting out travel papers and exchanging currency.
explanation.definitionFit: A revisal is a revision, the act of altering a text.

clue.text: Going back to help people brings much criticism

indicators.note: the word for helping is read backwards

parts.note: to aid is to help
a tribe is a people or clan

explanation.surface: Returning to assist the community draws heavy censure.
explanation.definitionFit: A bitter verbal attack, a lengthy tirade.

clue.text: Got very cold tossing dice

indicators.note: throwing dice mixes them up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone chilled to the bone while rolling dice.
explanation.definitionFit: Frozen over, chilled hard.

clue.text: State coppers love a politician

parts.note: copper coins are pennies, abbreviated p
love is zero in tennis, shaped like O
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: Police officers admire a Member of Parliament, as the nation says.
explanation.definitionFit: Ceremonial splendour, as in pomp and state.

clue.text: Whisper "Drink up, drink up!"

indicators.note: in a down clue the word is written upwards

parts.note: rum is an alcoholic drink

indicators.note: again the word is written upwards in the column

parts.note: rum again

explanation.surface: A soft-spoken urging to finish one's glass.
explanation.walkthrough: Each 'up' turns RUM into MUR in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A low, indistinct utterance, a whisper.

clue.text: The man at outside right or centre

parts.note: he is the pronoun for a man

indicators.note: the two letters wrap the letter for right

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A footballer placed at outside right or in the middle.
explanation.walkthrough: Outside right and centre are old football positions.
explanation.definitionFit: The core or middle of something.

clue.text: A mother given time for causing injury

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal, especially a horse
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: A mother handed time for inflicting harm.
explanation.definitionFit: Harm, as done by an injury.

clue.text: New resident being installed

indicators.note: the letters are made new, rearranged

explanation.surface: A newly arrived resident moving into a home.
explanation.definitionFit: Put in place, as a component is installed.

clue.text: Confronts very proper school-head

parts.note: meet means fitting or proper, an old-fashioned word

indicators.note: the head of school is its first letter

explanation.surface: Faces up to a strait-laced head teacher.
explanation.definitionFit: To face someone is to confront them.

clue.text: Plan to present a guy with a work of art

parts.note: a guy is a man
oeuvre is French for a work, used of an artist's output

explanation.surface: An offer to give a man a painting.
explanation.definitionFit: A scheme or tactical move.
